placements.why: The async job contract is an architectural decision about how the system's pipeline components interact — receipt-based dispatch, polling cursors, non-blocking guarantees — requiring an Architecture strata category to hold it, since nothing in the existing (empty) strata covers structural design decisions.
placements.title: structural design decisions governing system behavior
placements.frame: What architectural decisions define how the system's components interact and what guarantees they carry?

placements.title: async job contract ratified as non-blocking operational rules
placements.frame: How does the async job contract settle remember's behavior into non-blocking dispatch with guaranteed-no-lost-work retrieval?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the settling of the async job contract as decided operational rules rather than argued proposals. src-1 carries Wynn's ratified declaration of the receipt-and-cursor terms with explicit guarantees (no blocking call, no lost work); src-2 summarizes the key decision as prescribed procedure (dispatch, then poll or piggyback). This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding: how the async pipeline's contract is defined and guaranteed.
